messages.author: 99e3ad08a7577760
messages.subject: plot lines skipping values
parts:
Dear bloggers,

I am plotting a lines graph and I want to skip plotting data for 3 years (1996-1998):

ggplot(dataframe, aes(Year,Value,colour=factor(Type)))+
geom_line(size=1,linetype=c(1))

I have tried subsetting for specific years but it produces a very funny graph.

Any help on the matter is greatly appreciated!

Ale

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: plot lines skipping values
parts:
If your dataframe has NAs for those missing data, ggplot will skip
them correctly.

df <- data.frame(x=1:5,y=c(1,2,NA,4,5))
qplot(x,y,data=df,geom='line')

Is this what you want? If not, please give a reproducible example.
Ben
